Name: Synthesis
Description: nature of the middle marker (analytic or synthetic)

Name: Strategy
Description: morphosyntactic strategy of middle marker (suffix, prefix, person index, etc.)

Name: Passive
Description: Is the function "Passive" marked by the middle marker, by a different construction, by the middle and a competing construction, or does it not receive overt coding?

Name: Anticausative
Description: Is the function "Anticausative" marked by the middle marker, by a different construction, by the middle and a competing construction, or does it not receive overt coding?

Name: Reflexive
Description: Is the function "Reflexive" marked by the middle marker, by a different construction, by the middle and a competing construction, or does it not receive overt coding?

Name: Reciprocal
Description: Is the function "Reciprocal" marked by the middle marker, by a different construction, by the middle and a competing construction, or does it not receive overt coding?

Name: Antipassive
Description: Is the function "Antipassive" marked by the middle marker, by a different construction, by the middle and a competing construction, or does it not receive overt coding ?

Name: Self-benefactive
Description: Is the function "Self-benefactive" marked by the middle marker, or does it not receive overt coding?

Name: Impersonal
Description: Is the function "Impersonal" marked by the middle marker, or does it not receive overt coding?

Name: Facilitative
Description: Is the function "Facilitative" marked by the middle marker, or does it not receive overt coding?

Name: Other oppositional functions
Description: list of the other oppositional functions associated to the middle marker

Name: Syncretism pattern
Description: the syncretism pattern of the middle marker (includes all the oppositional valency related functions associated to the middle marker)

Name: Voice functions
Description: number of voice-related functions associated to the middle marker

Name: Diachronic source type
Description: diachronic source of the middle marker

Name: Nonreflexive source type
Description: more specific diachronic source of the middle marker if the source is not reflexive

Name: One vs. several middle markers
Description: Does the language have a single middle marker or several?

Name: Multiple middle markers: Cognacy
Description: If a language has more than one middle marker, are they cognate with each other?

Name: Multiple middle markers: Co-occurrence
Description: If a language has more than one middle marker, can they co-occur?

Name: Middle markers
Description: What are the shapes of the middle markers?
